author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:

author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:

Two dollars and thirteen cents isn't a wage; it's an insult that forces workers to beg for their survival. Abolish the tipped wage and pay the people who feed this country what they’re actually worth. That's the whole story.

author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:

text:

text:

text:
